title: Cycle the active physical sheet of each schematic
summary: Compiles the project, lists its physical documents and uses ILogicalDocument to make each channel of a repeated sheet active in turn, with an optional view notification broadcast.
phrasings: switch between channels of a multi-channel sheet
list the physical sheets of a repeated schematic
show each channel of a repeated sheet

commands.name: ListPhysicalSheets
commands.description: List the project's physical documents and, for each open schematic, its physical sheets and the active one

commands.name: CyclePhysicalSheets
commands.description: Compile the focused project, open each schematic and make each of its physical sheets active in turn
